sections.heading: Where it appears
lines: Battles inside generated villages (vanilla and modded variants).

sections.heading: Description
lines: City is a field effect exclusive to Rejuvenation. It is categorized as a Synthetic field and can be found in most major city areas, such as East Gearen City, West Gearen City, and Grand Dream City.

sections.heading: Transitions From Other Fields
lines: Back Alley will transform into this field if any of the moves Boomburst, Echoed Voice, Hyper Voice, or Uproar are used.
“Cops! Everyone scatter!”

sections.heading: General Effects
lines: Physical Normal-type moves increase in base power by 1.5x.
“The hustle and bustle of the city!”
Bug-type moves increase in base power by 1.3x.
“In the cracks and the walls!”
Poison-type moves increase in base power by 1.3x.
“All kinds of pollution strengthened the attack!”
Steel-type moves increase in base power by 1.3x.
“The right tool for the job!”
Fairy-type moves decrease in base power to 0.7x.
“This is no place for fairytales...”

sections.heading: Abilities Affected
lines: Big Pecks additionally boosts the user's Defense by 1 stage on switch in.
“[Pokémon]'s Big Pecks raise its Defense!”
Competitive boosts the bearer's Special Attack by 3 stages when activated.
Download boosts bearer's user's Attack or Special Attack by 2 stages when activated.
Early Bird additionally boosts the bearer's Attack by 1 stage on switch-in.
“The early bird catches the worm!”
Frisk additionally lowers the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
“Just a routine inspection.”
Hustle now boosts damage by 75%, but lowers accuracy by 33%.
Mimicry changes the bearer's type to Normal.
Pickup and Rattled additionally boost the bearer's Speed by 1 stage on switch in.
“The busy city is rattling [Pokémon]!”
“[Pokémon] is picking up Speed!”
Stench's activation chance is doubled to 20%.

sections.heading: Moves Affected
lines: Moves which receive an attack buff:
First Impression → 1.5x boost, Normal sub-typing.
“An overwhelming first impression!”
Beat Up, Pay Day, Smog, Steamroller, Techno Blast → 1.5x boost.
“A crowd is gathering!”
“Working 9 to 5 for this!”
“The city smog is suffocating!”
“Careful on the street!”
“The power of science is amazing!”
Other moves:
Autotomize boosts the user's Speed by 3 stages.
Corrosive Gas additionally lowers all of the target's stats by 1 stage.
Poison Gas and Smog never miss and inflict Bad Poison to the target.
Recycle additionally boosts a random stat of the user by 1 stage if successful.
“Reduce, reuse, recycle!”
Shift Gear boosts the user's Attack and Speed by 2 stages.
Smokescreen lowers the target's Accuracy by 2 stages.
Work Up boosts the user's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages.
Z-Celebrate, Z-Conversion, and Z-Happy Hour boost all of the user's stats by 2 stages.
Field-dependent moves:
Camouflage changes the user's type to Normal.
Nature Power becomes Smog.
Secret Power can inflict Poison.
Shelter halves damage from Normal-type moves.
Terrain Pulse's type becomes Normal.

sections.heading: Transitions to Other Fields
lines: Any move in this section inherently gains a 1.3x damage boost if it changes the field, unless noted otherwise.
This field will transform into Back Alley if any of the moves Covet, Pursuit, or Thief are used.
“The criminal ran into a backalley!”

sections.heading: Items
lines: Synthetic Seed boosts the user's Attack and Accuracy by 1 stage.
